jobs.label: Tracked twin-cannon anti-air vehicle
jobs.description: Compact low olive-drab armored tracked air-defense vehicle. Rectangular hull, TWO long black autocannon barrels symmetrically flanking the central turret, parallel to the ground and aimed screen north. Two broad continuous dark caterpillar tread top bands beside the hull. Top of rear engine cooling grilles, round hatch tops, a small flat radar-panel top and short antenna. One small helmet crown inside an open turret hatch with shoulders mostly occluded by armor, no external standing soldiers. Exactly two cannon barrels, no missiles or tank's single main gun.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Modern Age top-down RTS animated unit art for Age of Fronts.
Input image 1 is only the hand-painted materials, muted olive/steel palette and vertical overhead style reference. Replace its subject entirely.
Canvas: 1254 x 1254 RGBA, FOUR consecutive idle sprites of the SAME vehicle in a precise 2 x 2 grid, equal 627 x 627 cells, read left to right then next row.
Camera: exactly vertical overhead orthographic, pitch -90 degrees. Vehicle front and weapon fire direction both face NORTH, the top of the cell. Only horizontal roof, hull, barrel and equipment top surfaces. No isometric tilt, perspective, visible side body panels, circular road-wheel side faces, crew faces or upright vehicle fronts. Wheel tires appear as narrow top tread bands. Gun barrels and missile tubes lie parallel to the ground, not pointing toward the viewer; forward tips appear edge-on, not circular upward-facing bore holes.
Style: crisp realistic hand-painted game sprite, weathered olive steel, readable machinery and silhouette, restrained short contact shadows and metal edge wear. No cutaway, schematic, text, flags, markings, watermark, environment patch, solid backdrop or checkerboard. Genuine alpha outside the vehicle.
Framing: same scale and fixed chassis coordinates in ALL FOUR cells; entire vehicle with every barrel, track, tire and attachment stays at least 40 pixels inside each cell edge. Clear transparent center gutters.
Animation: FOUR subtle IDLE poses. Chassis, hull, wheels and weapon position do not move or change design. Tiny antenna settling or sensor scanning only, small hatch crew breathing if visible. No movement across cells, firing, flash, smoke or missing equipment.
